WITH 
-- Calculate the number of customers per segment for each year
segment_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        DATE_TRUNC('year', Date) AS Year,
        Segment,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN 1 END) AS SME_Count,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN 1 END) AS LAM_Count,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN 1 END) AS KAM_Count
    FROM yearmonth
    WHERE Date >= '201301' AND Date <= '201312'
    GROUP BY Year, Segment
),
-- Calculate total consumption per customer per segment per year
segment_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        Year,
        Segment,
        SUM(Consumption) AS Total_Consumption
    FROM yearmonth
    WHERE Date >= '201301' AND Date <= '201312'
    GROUP BY Year, Segment
),
-- Calculate the number of customers with the lowest consumption in each segment
segment_lowest AS (
    SELECT 
        Year,
        Segment,
        MIN(Consumption) AS Min_Consumption,
        COUNT(*) AS Count
    FROM yearmonth
    WHERE Date >= '201301' AND Date <= '201312'
    GROUP BY Year, Segment
),
-- Calculate the average consumption for each segment (total / count)
segment_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        Year,
        Segment,
        AVG(Consumption) AS Avg_Consumption
    FROM yearmonth
    WHERE Date >= '201301' AND Date <= '201312'
    GROUP BY Year, Segment
)
-- Calculate the difference in annual averages between SME and LAM
diff_sme_lam AS (
    SELECT 
        Year,
        Segment,
        AVG(Consumption) AS Avg_SME,
        AVG(Consumption) AS Avg_LAM
    FROM segment_avg
    WHERE Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM')
    GROUP BY Year, Segment
),
-- Calculate the difference in annual averages between LAM and KAM
diff_lam_kam AS (
    SELECT 
        Year,
        Segment,
        AVG(Consumption) AS Avg_LAM,
        AVG(Consumption) AS Avg_KAM
    FROM segment_avg
    WHERE Segment IN ('LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY Year, Segment
),
-- Calculate the difference in annual averages between KAM and SME
diff_kam_sme AS (
    SELECT 
        Year,
        Segment,
        AVG(Consumption) AS Avg_KAM,
        AVG(Consumption) AS Avg_SME
    FROM segment_avg
    WHERE Segment IN ('KAM', 'SME')
    GROUP BY Year, Segment
)
-- Final query to find the difference for each pair
SELECT 
    dsl.Year,
    dsl.Segment,
    dsl.Avg_SME,
    dsl.Avg_LAM,
    dsl.Avg_KAM,
    dsl.Avg_SME - dsl.Avg_LAM AS Diff_SME_LAM,
    dsl.Avg_LAM - dsl.Avg_KAM AS Diff_LAM_KAM,
    dsl.Avg_KAM - dsl.Avg_SME AS Diff_KAM_SME
FROM diff_sme_lam dsl
JOIN diff_lam_kam dl on dl.Year = dsl.Year AND dl.Segment = dsl.Segment
JOIN diff_kam_sme dk on dk.Year = dsl.Year AND dk.Segment = dsl.Segment
WHERE dk.Segment = dk.Segment

WITH 
-- Calculate consumption for each segment for each year
segment_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(CAST(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS INTEGER) AS SegmentID,
        CAST(CAST(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS INTEGER) AS SegmentID2,
        CAST(CAST(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS INTEGER) AS SegmentID3,
        SUM(Consumption) AS TotalConsumption,
        SUM(Consumption) * 100.0 / SUM(Consumption) AS PercentageIncrease
    FROM yearmonth
    WHERE Date >= '2012-01-01' AND Date <= '2013-12-31'
    GROUP BY SegmentID, SegmentID2, SegmentID3
),
-- Calculate percentage increase for each segment
segment_increase AS (
    SELECT 
        SegmentID,
        SegmentID2,
        SegmentID3,
        PercentageIncrease
    FROM segment_consumption
),
-- Calculate total consumption for each segment
segment_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        SegmentID,
        SUM(Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM yearmonth
    WHERE Date >= '2012-01-01' AND Date <= '2013-12-31'
    GROUP BY SegmentID
),
-- Calculate percentage increase for each segment
segment_increase_pct AS (
    SELECT 
        s1.SegmentID,
        s2.SegmentID2,
        s3.SegmentID3,
        s1.PercencyIncrease,
        s2.PercencyIncrease,
        s3.PercencyIncrease,
        s1.TotalConsumption,
        s2.TotalConsumption,
        s3.TotalConsumption
    FROM segment_increase s1
    JOIN segment_totals s2 ON s1.SegmentID = s2.SegmentID
    JOIN segment_totals s3 ON s1.SegmentID = s3.SegmentID
)
SELECT 
    s1.SegmentID,
    s1.PercencyIncrease,
    s2.SegmentID,
    s2.PercencyIncrease,
    s3.SegmentID,
    s3.PercencyIncrease
FROM segment_increase s1
JOIN segment_increase_pct s2 ON s1.SegmentID = s2.SegmentID
JOIN segment_increase s3 ON s1.SegmentID = s3.SegmentID
ORDER BY s1.PercencyIncrease DESC, s2.PercencyIncrease DESC, s3.PercencyIncrease DESC

sql:
SELECT 
    c.CustomerID,
    c.Segment,
    c.Currency,
    COALESCE(SUM(p.Price), 0) AS TotalPrice,
    COALESCE(SUM(p.Amount), 0) AS TotalAmount,
    AVG(p.Price) AS AvgPricePerItem
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN products p ON c.CustomerID = p.ProductID
WHERE c.CustomerID IN (
    SELECT CustomerID
    FROM "transactions_1k"
    GROUP BY CustomerID
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
)
GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment, c.Currency
ORDER BY TotalPrice DESC
text:

    c.CustomerID,

    c.Currency,
    COALESCE(SUM(p.Price), 0) AS TotalPrice,

    AVG(p.Price) AS AvgPricePerItem

    FROM "transactions_1k"

    member m ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id

        AND (month(e.date_received) = 9 OR month(e.date_received) = 10)
    )
GROUP BY 
    m.member_id
ORDER BY 
    total_cost DESC

    FROM Player

  AND player_name = 'Jordan Bowery'
  AND overall_rating_diff > 0

SELECT 
    r.driverId,
    COUNT(r.statusId) AS accidentCount
FROM races r
JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN constructors c ON d.constructorId = c.constructorId
JOIN constructorStandings cs ON r.raceId = cs.raceId
JOIN constructorStandings rs ON cs.constructorId = rs.constructorId
JOIN drivers d2 ON rs.driverId = d2.driverId
WHERE r.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix'
GROUP BY r.driverId
HAVING COUNT(r.statusId) = (
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    FROM races r2
    JOIN drivers d2 ON r2.driverId = d2.driverId
    JOIN constructors c2 ON d2.constructorId = c2.constructorId
    JOIN constructorStandings cs2 ON r2.raceId = cs2.raceId
    JOIN drivers d3 ON cs2.driverId = d3.driverId
    WHERE r2.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix'
    GROUP BY r2.driverId
    HAVING COUNT(r2.statusId) > 0
))
ORDER BY accidentCount DESC

    c.name,
    c.artist,
    c.isPromo
FROM 
    cards c
JOIN 
    rulings r ON c.uuid = r.uuid
WHERE 
    c.uuid IN (
        SELECT uuid
        FROM rulings
        GROUP BY uuid
        HAVING COUNT(*) > (
            SELECT COUNT(*)
            FROM rulings
            WHERE isPromo = 1
        )
    )
ORDER BY 
    COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT s.School, s.Street, s.StreetAbr, s.City, s.Zip, s.State, s.MailCity, s.MailZip, s.MailState, s.MailStreet, s.MailStrAbr, s.MailEmail1, s.MailEmail2, s.MailEmail3, s.MailEmail4, s.MailEmail5, s.MailPhone, s.Electronics, s.Email, s.WebSite, s.OpenDate, s.ClosedDate, s.Charter, s.CharterNum, s.FundingType, s.DOC, s.DOCType, s.SOC, s.SOCType, s.EdOpsCode, s.EdOpsName, s.EILCode, s.EILName, s.GSoffered, s.GSserved, s.Virtual, s.Magnet, s.Latitude, s.Longitude, s.AdmFName1, s.AdmLName1, s.AdmEmail1, s.AdmFName2, s.AdmLName2, s.AdmEmail2, s.AdmFName3, s.AdmLName3, s.AdmEmail3, s.LastUpdate
FROM schools s
WHERE s.Charter = 1
  AND s.CharterNum IS NOT NULL
  AND s.FundingType IN ('Federal', 'State')
  AND s.DOC IS NOT NULL
  AND s.DOCType IN ('Federal', 'State')
  AND s.GSserved = 'Yes'
  AND s.GSoffered = 'Yes'
  AND s.Magnet = 1
  AND s.Latitude IS NOT NULL
  AND s.Longitude IS NOT NULL
  AND s.LastUpdate IS NOT NULL
WHERE s.Enrollment (K-12) - s.Enrollment (Ages 5-17) > 30;

       WHERE f2.FundingType = 'LOCAL'
         AND s3.Enrollment (Ages 5-17) - s3.Enrollment (K-12) > 0
       )
   )
ORDER BY s.school
